text:
maria-people: Quick question — we have a 6-month contractor starting Nov 15. Manager asked whether they accrue PTO during their contract and if any unused days can be carried if their contract is extended. Also: their term overlaps the company year-end blackout (Dec 20–31). Manager wants to offer a holiday-coverage swap (cover Xmas shift in exchange for a day off later). Is that allowed and how should we document it?

jon-payroll: Short answer: contractors generally do not accrue PTO unless the contract explicitly includes paid time off. If the SOW/contract has a PTO clause we follow that. No standard carryover for contractors.

alisha-hrbp: Adding detail: our policy is employee PTO accrual only. Exceptions can be made for "long-term temps" (>=6 months) if approved by People Ops + Finance and added to the contract. For a 6-month fixed-term, we can "make whole" via a comp day or one-off stipend, but it MUST be in writing before the contract starts.

sam-engineering: Manager here. They start 11/15 so they'd hit ~6–7 weeks before blackout. The team wants to offer a swap: teammate covers Dec 25 shift, contractor takes an alternate day off in Jan. Is that something we can approve informally? :thinking_face:

alisha-hrbp: Informal swaps between peers are fine for scheduling, but for a contractor we need the cover/swap documented. Options: 1) Manager sends a confirmation email thread and we attach it to the contractor file, 2) Better: update the contract with a 1-day "comp-time" clause or add a written addendum.

jon-payroll: If you go with comp-time, payroll needs a record so we can process it (for accrual/stipend if applicable). Minimal CSV we accept: 

```
worker_id, reason, comp_date, pay_code
12345, "comp for holiday coverage", 2026-01-04, COMP-DAY
```

Send to payroll@redwood.com and cc: alisha-hrbp. We can code it as non-accruing comp day for contractors.

maria-people: calendar-bot shows blackout so want to be careful. Also manager asked if we can make a 1-day carryover exception if they extend contract through Feb.

alisha-hrbp: If contract is extended before original end date and extension is >=30 days, we can add a prorated PTO accrual (one-time) via contract amendment. But carryover beyond the contract end is not typical — prefer to convert to a comp-day or add stipend. For recordkeeping: put the amendment in the contract repo and file a People Ops ticket (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue.jspa).

sam-engineering: Sounds good. I'll ask the manager to (1) confirm swap in email, (2) have legal/ops add the addendum if we want comp-day in contract, or (3) just send the CSV to payroll for a one-off comp-day. Which is fastest?

jon-payroll: Fastest = CSV + payroll email for a single comp-day. Legal path takes longer. If you need it retroactive/paid out, we need it in contract before start date or post-hire amendment approved by legal + finance.

calendar-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout window is active 2026-12-20 to 2026-12-31. All time-off approvals during blackout require manager + People Ops approval.

maria-people: Thanks all — manager will confirm swap via email and we'll send CSV to payroll if they opt for comp-day. Alisha, I'll open the People Ops ticket for record. :thumbsup:
